unroad.skipped: source 30 m resolves no road cut or fill (rule runs at <= 10 m)

hydro.channels.method: least-cost breach (<= 300 m) of depressions >= 1 m outside waterbodies (human water rewilded: not held as ponds, routed on terrain/dem_rewilded.tif), then pysheds fill + resolve_flats, D8, NHD-seeded inflow, edge leaks handed back to their NHD stream

client.channel_depth.encoding: uint8 decimetres: mean DEM on a 20 m ring minus the channel cell, clamped 0-25 m, x10; 0 off channel

hydro.human_water.rule: human: NHD FType 436; OSM water=reservoir/basin/wastewater or landuse=reservoir/basin; an OSM dam within 25 m (line) or 80 m (NID point); or a pond under 1.5 ha whose ring is straight (>= 12 m, RMS <= 0.12 of its length) at its outlet with ground >= 1.5 m below the water 15-45 m beyond it (on a creek >= 5 km2: RMS <= 0.08, >= 2 m). Everything else kept.

terrain.dem_rewilded.modification: terrain/dem.tif with a thalweg carved through each rewilded bed that has a channel: least-cost path down the middle of the old flat from each inflow to the outlet, lowered 0.2 m below the old water level at the inflow to 1.2 m at the outlet, parabolic 8 m wide; never raised. Routing (hydro.channels) runs on this copy; the client terrain does not show it.

client.channel_profile.encoding: RGB, row 0 north. R thalweg water depth, 2 cm units (0-5.1 m), 0 off channel; G riffle-pool index (0 deepest pool, 128 run, 255 riffle; local width = reach width x (1 + 0.15 (G/127.5 - 1))); B rewilded water: 255 former open water (meadow or wet flat), 160 riparian corridor within 12 m of the restored channel, 0 elsewhere. R and G are spread 4 px from each centreline.
client.channel_profile.depth_model: mean depth 0.10 A^0.32 m (A km2) x exp(-0.85 t), t = tanh(1.1 ln((S_local + 0.002) / (S_reach + 0.002))); S_local over max(7.5 m, 2.5 widths), S_reach over max(75 m, 10 widths), on the non-increasing DEM long profile every 2.5 m

client.features.encoding: tile-local metres [x east, north from south edge]

groups.name: Polar/alpine cliffs, screes, outcrops and lava flows

terrain.ice.encoding: uint8 1 = permanent snow or ice; client/ice.png 255 = ice at 30 m

terrain.dem_banked.modification: terrain/dem.tif with every channel carved to its graded cross-section (channel bed L - D(1 - (o/wh)^2), wet margin, bank and the pond basins; cells only lowered, at most 3 m); the client's heights come from it

client.water.encoding: RGB, row 0 north. R: zone (low 4 bits; 1 channel bed, 2 wet margin, 3 bank, 4 terrace, 5 pond water, 6 pond margin, 7 pond shore, 8 pond terrace) | stream order << 4 | 128 perennial. G: bed material (low 3 bits: 1 silt, 2 sand, 3 gravel, 4 cobble, 5 boulder) | 8 bar. B: water level = heights.png height at the cell + (B - 128) x 0.02 m (0: none). client/water_width.png (8-bit grey, same grid): water half width at the nearest centreline sample, 0.1 m units

hydro.water_reaches.encoding: per drawn reach: id, name, order, area_km2, width, class (0 ephemeral, 1 intermittent, 2 perennial), samples, length; the kept ponds' basins

client.geology.encoding: R = geology unit index (geology/classes.json units; 0 none), G = rock class index (1-based into rock_classes)

client.outcrop.formula: outcrop = clip(resistance[rock_class] * shallowness * terrain * (1 - tree_cover_pct/100 * 0.5), 0, 1); shallowness = clip((150 - depth_to_bedrock_cm) / (150 - 25), 0, 1) (0 where depth unknown); terrain = min(slope_deg / 35, 1) + 0.5 * clip(TPI_m / 1.5, 0, 1), TPI = z - mean(z, 150 m window) on the DEM averaged to 30 m; tree cover from LANDFIRE EVC; water = 0

client.canopy.encoding: R tree %, G shrub %, B herb %

footprint.urban.encoding: uint8, row 0 north: 1 densely built (streets, blocks and street trees rewilded whole), 0 not
footprint.urban.method: OSM building cover (rasterised at 2.5 m) averaged within 100 m; dense where >= 0.15, or >= 0.075 on LANDFIRE EVT Developed-Medium / High Intensity cells; kept within 25 m of a building or on those cells; closed by 40 m, enclosed gaps under 3 ha filled, components under 75 ha dropped

client.roads.encoding: road weight, 0 everywhere: roads are rewilded (footprint.roads holds where they were); kept as a file for the client's ground-data texture (R)

client.masks.encoding: R grassland, G oak woodland, B chaparral weights

client.texture_present.encoding: NAIP RGB as captured (present day, human footprint kept); JPEG q88

roads.rule: every road's pavement and verge erased (footprint.roads > ROAD_ERASE): mirrored from the ground beside it where nothing else is erased, else filled like the rest

client.texture_imagery.encoding: NAIP RGB with the human footprint, roads included, inpainted or synthesized; JPEG q88

encoding.B: exposed patch size: round(32 log2(1 + area / 100 m2)), 0 outside a patch

seasons.s2_monthly.encoding: float32 per calendar month, bands red green blue (surface reflectance 0..1) and NDVI; median over all clear looks of all years; NaN where no look

method.fill: pixels under min_looks (or a whole refused month) take the mean of the nearest months either side with enough looks

layout.order: month m (1-12) at column (m-1) % 4, row (m-1) // 4, rows top to bottom; each frame north-up on the tile grid, pixel centres as other client rasters

client.season_rgb.encoding: RGB = 255 * sRGB_encode(clamp(surface reflectance / 0.35, 0, 1)) of bands B04 B03 B02: sampled as an sRGB texture, the linear value times 0.35 is reflectance

layout.order: month m (1-12) at column (m-1) % 4, row (m-1) // 4, rows top to bottom; each frame north-up on the tile grid, pixel centres as other client rasters

client.season_ndvi.encoding: grey byte = 255 * (NDVI - (-0.2)) / 1.1, clamped: 0 = NDVI -0.2, 255 = 0.9; NDVI = (B08 - B04) / (B08 + B04), median of per-look NDVI

client.weather.credit: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (https://open-meteo.com), CC BY 4.0
client.weather.clock: local wall-clock time from UTC via zoneinfo; DST days padded/trimmed to 24 rows (the skipped spring-forward hour repeats the row before it, the repeated fall-back hour keeps its first)
client.weather.encoding: compact JSON; days keyed by local date YYYY-MM-DD; per day sunrise / sunset 'HH:MM', tmax / tmin deg C, precip_mm (the local day's hours), and hourly: 24 rows (index = local wall-clock hour) of `fields`; null = no value. Clock: see `clock`; utc_offset_seconds is standard time. Units: temp_c deg C, humidity %, precip_mm / rain_mm mm in the hour, snow_cm cm fallen in the hour, snow_depth_m m on the ground, cloud* % cover, wind_kmh / gust_kmh km/h at 10 m, wind_dir deg the wind comes from, code WMO weather code

stats_rules.snow_days: snowfall summed over the day >= 0.5 cm

client.species_mix.encoding: format 2: species_mix_index L = row in mixes; species_mix_density RGB = tree_density, shrub_density (byte/100); per-row weights as mixes[].tree_bytes / shrub_bytes over species.trees / species.shrubs

species.occurrences.for_clients_note: per-record licences include CC BY-NC; clients read client.species_prior, built from CC0 and CC BY records only

client.species_prior.encoding: w: base64 uint8, cells x cells; w / 255 = d / (d + mean), d = usable records per 100 m cell summed over an 11 x 11 box (about 500 m radius), mean = mean of the non-zero d
client.species_prior.use: prior = 0.6 + 0.8 * w / 255 (0.6 unrecorded .. 1.4 heavily recorded); a species recorded only under licences a client may not carry is listed with a flat 0 (0.6); species with no record at all: 1 (neutral)

client.texture_ground.method: imagery blended toward leaf litter (82, 67, 50) by tree cover (0.3 none to 0.9 full, 85 %), the imagery's luminance kept as variation; no point cloud on the tile

client.texture_ground_mask.encoding: 8-bit grey, row 0 north: the litter blend's weight (255 full)

geology.strata.reason: 1 bedrock unit(s) large enough: no column

client.canopy_top.encoding: R = the stand's top height in 0.5 m steps (0 none): the mean p95 height of the cell's 10 m sub-cells with tree cover >= 12 %, where 1 or more of them do; else the mean of the measured cells within 2 cells. Map by rule (pipeline/canopy_top.py)

maps.rule: CHM v2 (v1 at v2's level where v2 has no data), lifted to ETH's level where v2 sees tall closed forest

vegetation.canopy_height_v2_10m.encoding: band 1 the p95 height (m) of the 10 m cell's 2 m means of the 1 m map, band 2 tree cover (>= 4 m) %, band 3 shrub cover (0.5-4 m) %; -9999 off the map

vegetation.canopy_height_eth_10m.encoding: band 1 the canopy top height (m; GEDI RH98-calibrated), band 2 its standard deviation (m); -9999 no data

hydro.waterbody_seasons.method: every mapped waterbody against the tile's monthly Sentinel-2 composites (pipeline/water_seasons.py)

rule.bands: seasons/s2_MM.tif red, green, blue, NDVI (no SWIR); NIR = red (1 + NDVI) / (1 - NDVI)
rule.water_pixel: NDWI (green - NIR) / (green + NIR) > 0 or NIR < 0.04, and not bright
rule.bright_pixel: green >= 0.2 or (NDVI < 0.1 and blue >= 0.12): ice, snow, cloud (not counted)
rule.core: the polygon inset 10 m (pixels wholly inside), at least 2 pixels
rule.wet_month: water fraction of the core's clear pixels >= 0.25; observed when clear >= half the core
rule.classes: dry: wet in none of >= 3 observed months; permanent: wet in >= 75% of them; seasonal: the rest; unresolved: by the tags
rule.dry_bed: meadow when the greenest observed month's median NDVI >= 0.3, else bare

client.ground_albedo.encoding: gain: per channel (linear R G B) the factor from the ground texture's linear colour to surface reflectance; the client multiplies the ground and the herb layer's albedo by it (by its luminance, gain_luminance, by default); saturation: the chroma scale about the luminance (Rec. 601) that the client applies with the luminance factor
client.ground_albedo.method: sum of the reference month's L2A reflectance over the sum of the texture's linear colour, open ground (tree < 10 %, shrub < 15 %, not water or built), 20 m

encoding_check.note: the texture's own encoding (2.5 x the three-year median reflectance); the fit also carries the reference month against that median

hydro.water_imagery.method: the reverse test of mapped water: drawn reaches against the imagery's water, the large rivers moved onto it (pipeline/water_imagery.py)

rule.water_pixel: seasons/s2_MM.tif: NDWI (NIR from red and NDVI) > 0 or NIR < 0.04, not bright (water_seasons.py)
rule.water: per 20 m pixel max(frequency, fraction): frequency = wet months / observed (>= 3); fraction = its NDWI's 75th percentile over the clear months unmixed between the never-wet land within 300 m and the tile's always-wet water (median NDWI; 0.3 with under 10 such pixels); DEM slope < 0.2, DEM > 0.5 m; bilinear onto the 5 m grid, water at >= 0.5
rule.naip: imagery/naip.tif is RGB (no NIR band): not used
rule.reach: on: water within max(w/2, 10 m); near: within max(60 m, 2 w); every 10 m; on water >= 0.6, off water: near >= 0.5, else no water seen
rule.move: stems of DEM reaches with width >= 10 m not on water: least-cost path on the 5 m grid within 600 m of the drawn stem on ground <= 10 m over its nearest DEM line cell (water 1 + 2 exp(-d_in/6 m), land 12 x (0.4 + 0.6 min(1, d_dem/30 m))), edge ends fixed, interior ends snapped to water within 60 m, a junction on a moved stem taken as moved, smoothed 10 m; kept when on >= 0.5 and >= the old line's + 0.2; the reaches meeting a moved node bent to it over 2 |shift| + 20 m (shift <= 30 m) or extended straight to it (one per node)
rule.nhd_dropped: NHD-sourced stretches with width >= 10 m, no water seen, within 600 m of a moved stem's old or new line, off the tile edge: the map's pieces of a river where the imagery shows none
rule.width: a moved reach takes the water's median cross-section when >= 40 m and wider than drawn
rule.side_channels: the river's water within 250 m, off the moved ribbon (w/2 + 10 m), its skeleton's longest path >= 150 m: a reach at its measured width (source imagery)
rule.undrawn: water patches >= 1600 m2 beyond w/2 + 20 m of every reach and 20 m of every kept pond

hydro.channels_dem.encoding: the channels as the DEM routed them (after the reroute step), before the water_imagery step moved the large rivers onto the imagery's water

footprint.roads.encoding: where the roads were: weight 0..255 (255 pavement, verge 136 falling to 0; tracks half weight), every road; pipeline only (the imagery erase), the client's roads are 0
